Priya: Quick pulse — realtime-routing milestone status for the OKR check. Need a very short update: what shipped, what slipped, who's owning next steps.
Ethan: Shipped: route-optimizer v2 canary rolled yesterday, PR #418 merged. https://git.redwood/ri/pr/418 :thumbsup:
Maya: Confirmed canary in eu-west-1 looks stable. p50 down ~12%, errors ~unchanged. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jared: Slipped: metrics dashboard integration (owner: Jared) is blocked on infra schema change from eng-infra (INF-992).
Jared: New ETA EOD next Wed — trying to parallelize but will need a small migration from Lina.
Lina: Pushed a migration diff for the schema, opened PR #425. small change but touches event pipeline.
Lina: code snippet for reviewers:
```
ALTER TABLE routing_metrics ADD COLUMN region VARCHAR;
UPDATE routing_metrics SET region = 'unknown' WHERE region IS NULL;
```
Lina: @Ethan if you can do a quick CR this morning that would help unblock Jared.
Ethan: Ping received — will review PR #425 by EOD today, prioritizing the migration.
Priya: Owner map for follow-ups: infra migration -> Lina, metrics dashboard -> Jared, docs/runbook -> Maya. Who can take the runbook?
Maya: I'll draft the runbook and short howto once the migration is merged.
Priya: Next steps: Jared update INF-992 with test plan + final ETA; Lina request CR reminder; Ethan land the migration; Maya publish runbook. If anything slips, fallback is the existing routing config (auto-fallback already configured).
ops-bot: Canary passed in us-west-2 — health checks green, no rollout alarms.
Maya: Quick CR ping again: @Ethan @Lina please prioritize review this morning — migration is small but affects downstream dashboards.
Ethan: Reviewing now.
Jared: FYI logging library needs bump to 2.1.0 for the migration to be compatible. If that blocks, we can behind-flag the dashboard change.
Ethan: LGTM, merged PR #425.
Maya: Runbook published: https://confluence.redwood/realtime-routing-runbook — notes included about rollback and toggles.
Priya: Thanks — I updated the OKR micro-status doc with shipped/slipped/owners. If anything else comes up, reply here and I'll fold into the weekly summary. :memo:
